en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone square lined with traditional European townhouses. The central building is a mid‑size hotel with the word "HOTEL" prominent on its facade and an awning‑covered terrace with climbing plants labeled "goldne Sonne". Neighboring buildings host various shops and businesses, and several pedestrians stand or walk along the street. The architecture suggests an early 20th‑century small town in a German‑speaking region.
